title: alyssum petraeum subsp. microcarpon
intro: Alyssum petraeum subsp. microcarpon, commonly known as Alpine sweet alyssum, is a species of flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its potential to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Alpine sweet alyssum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
